user_reviews.Description:
I had a great stay at Glow Inn Hotel, located right in the heart of Paharganj, New Delhi. The location is perfect — it’s very easy to commute to different parts of the city and the New Delhi Railway Station is just a short walk away.
The staff here are friendly and helpful, always ready to assist with anything you need. The food is really good, and the service is excellent too. Overall, it’s a comfortable and convenient place to stay for travelers.

user_reviews.Name: MD JAVID
user_reviews.Description:
Recently, I had an opportunity to stay at this hotel during my visit to New Delhi, and I must say that the overall experience turned out to be extremely pleasant and comfortable for me and my family. I would definitely consider this hotel as one of the best options available near New Delhi Railway Station, especially for travellers who are visiting the city with family members. The location itself is one of the biggest advantages. It is situated just around 500 meters from the New Delhi railway station, which means you can simply walk to the hotel without having to spend money on a cab or auto. This becomes even more convenient when you are carrying luggage or travelling with children and elders.

Another highlight of the hotel is the spacious room arrangement they provided. The room we booked had six beds, and this was something that suited our big family perfectly. Many hotels claim to offer family rooms, but very few are actually prepared to accommodate large families comfortably. However, here we were provided with a room that was absolutely suitable for all of us, with enough space for everyone. The room was neat, properly arranged, and very comfortable for a long stay. Spending time inside the room was actually relaxing, something we did not expect in such a busy and crowded locality like central Delhi.

One of the most impressive aspects of this hotel is the behaviour and nature of the hotel owner. He is a very humble, polite, and genuine person. From the moment we contacted him for booking, he communicated everything clearly and honestly. Whatever he promised before arrival, he fulfilled after we reached. There were no hidden charges, no last-minute changes, and no confusion. The room that he assured us was exactly the same room that we received. Nowadays it is difficult to find hotel owners who speak kindly, keep their word, and actually treat customers with respect, so this was truly appreciated by us.

We also liked the hospitality of the staff. They were helpful, responsive and treated us with respect throughout our stay. Every time we needed anything, they attended to us quickly with a friendly attitude. The cleanliness of the room as well as the washroom was maintained very well, and we could clearly notice that hygiene was given importance. This added a very positive feeling to our stay.

The hotel is also located right in a well-known shopping market area. So, if you are someone who enjoys shopping or wishes to buy clothes, accessories or gift items, this location is very convenient. We could easily go out, walk around, explore shops, and return without needing any transport. After checking out items in the nearby marketplace, we realized that staying here gave us a lot of convenience compared to staying in other parts of Delhi.

Overall, I personally felt that this hotel is highly suitable for large families who want a safe location, comfortable rooms, and a helpful hotel owner. The combination of spacious accommodation, excellent location, and polite service makes this hotel a very good option. So if you are planning a family trip to Delhi, especially near New Delhi Railway Station, I would strongly recommend choosing this hotel. Our stay was extremely satisfying, and we truly felt our money was worth it.

user_reviews.Name: TANMOY GOSWAMI
user_reviews.Description:
Pros: Location is 10 min walking to New Delhi station and all restaurants are nearby.
Cons: Non AC room doesnot justify Rs 1400 per day at the condition of the furniture and room. Room No 312 had nearly 50 cockroaches at checkin which was later brought to control through repellent.
Do not be deceived by the colourful photos posted by the property, as reality doesn't go close to that.
Rs 300 was charged for early check-in at 8am instead of 12pm, which is pure business, as we checked out at 7am instead of 12pm and we stayed for less than 24 hours paying additional Rs 300.
Hotel is a lot shabby and so so, but definitely the price doesn't justify the amenities.

user_reviews.Name: Soela Bose
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed at this hotel two years ago, but now its condition has become really poor. The room maintenance is terrible. They promise to provide AC, but you won’t even get the remote—and the AC itself is in such bad condition that it hardly works.

When you order food, it takes more than an hour, and even then you’ll have to call them again only to hear that they “forgot” your order. This didn’t happen just once—it happened repeatedly, every single day.

Early in the morning, someone will ring your doorbell by mistake and say, “Sorry, we rang the wrong room—the order was for the floor above.” It was extremely harassing for us.

I would strongly suggest not staying at this hotel. It’s located quite far inside the lane, and you’ll easily find much better hotels on the main road at a lower budget.

user_reviews.Name: tomas hlavicka
user_reviews.Description: A nightmare experience. I book thru Agoda. Then called them. Receptionist told me on the phone to cancel Agoda reservation (you dont need double booking - he said) and confirmed "your reservation is confirmed sir, de luxe room with BF, you can pay with card on arrival". What happened next: Some polite indian lady who booked her room, was scared after they showed her the room: GF-1, just next to lobby. She saw the condition of the room, then she saw me and told me she already paid for it, but doesnt want to stay there and if i pay her back, i can stay there. Deal done, i am from europe, had nowhere to go at 1am in Delhi... So i slept in a room where i had to flush the toilet with a bucket of water. Overall, it was a nice experience.

I would suggest to book it on a weekday as you can strike a good deal!

Comfortable and safe stay for families

We stayed at Hotel Sun International with our family and had a very pleasant experience. The hotel is easy to reach and located close to New Delhi Railway Station, which made our arrival and travel very convenient.

The staff was very polite and supportive. They helped us with extra towels, guidance about local travel, and made check-in smooth even with children. Everyone was respectful and friendly.

Tourist attractions, markets, and shopping areas are very close, making it easy to plan outings without long travel.

For the price, this hotel is a great choice for families. Clean rooms, safe environment, and helpful staff made our stay comfortable and stress-free.

We would definitely recommend Hotel Sun International to families visiting Delhi.

user_reviews.Description:
This hotel should not be listed on any booking platform. Sun International Hotel, Delhi is in an extremely poor and unhygienic condition, and the staff behavior makes it even worse.

The room was filthy. The bed sheets were dirty, stained, and clearly reused. There was no dustbin in the room, and when I asked for one, they handed over a broken, dirty dustbin that looked like it came straight from a trash area.

The bathroom experience was horrifying. I requested bathroom slippers and was shocked beyond words  they gave me used, worn-out men’s slippers, clearly reused by multiple guests. This is disgusting, unsafe, and a serious hygiene violation.

Housekeeping is non-existent. The flush was not working, and despite repeatedly calling reception, I was casually told that the plumber was “not available.” No urgency, no solution, no apology. Just indifference.

Take a look at the windows and overall room condition  broken, dirty, poorly maintained, and neglected. The room felt uncomfortable and unclean.

What’s even more unacceptable is the staff’s arrogant attitude. When I raised these issues and mentioned that I had paid via MakeMyTrip, the response was shocking:
👉 They openly said they “don’t care about MMT.”
This clearly shows how little they respect guests and booking platforms.

I booked this hotel after seeing some positive reviews, and I feel completely misled. The reality is the rooms are terrible, hygiene is zero, and service is careless and rude.

I have attached images as proof of the dirty bed sheets, broken dustbin, filthy slippers, broken flush, window condition, and overall room state.

Avoid this hotel at all costs. This place is not worth your money, your time, or your health. One of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

Very okay hotel. It is in an old building, which has its pros and cons.

Overall pros:
- good value for money
- away from the hustle and bustle of the street
- the room was spacious, with a high ceiling
- even in the hottest weather (current temp. in New Delhi is 42*C) it heats up much less than in other hotels
- the water in the bathroom also remains pleasantly cool
- large, comfortable bed
- we were lucky that our room had a window and was bright
- quiet fan
- towels, they are not snow-white, but they are clean and stay fresh for a long time (usually after 3..4 uses hotel towels start to smell bad - these do not)
- access to drinking water
- large and pleasant lobby
- there is an elevator
- good Wi-Fi
- spacious terrace with a view, where you can also dry your laundry
- ZERO bugs

- the staff is very friendly, kind and discreet (both at the reception and the gentlemen taking care of cleanliness) 🙂
- I also think that they are friendly to LGBTQ+ people 🏳️‍🌈

Cons
- the room and bathroom are a bit worn out, but it doesn't affect functionality
- the floor in the bathroom and room, sink, mirror, countertops of cabinets and tables are also a bit dirty and neglected; they are rather dusted than washed (acceptable for me, but it may bother someone else)
- it happens there is water shortage from time to time, but it doesn't last long
- when we were checking out, some gentleman (maybe a superior) who appeared from time to time at the reception, stopped us trying to arrange the payment. This caused us to be seriously late for the bus. He could have done it so many times before when he saw us. He could also have been overseeing the formalities as they happened.

If someone after visiting this hotel is going to point out the paint peeling off the wall or a small hole in the sheet, they should better go straight to a 5-star hotel and not ruin the rating here.

Generally, we booked 2 nights and ended up staying for 9.
I highly recommend this hotel, as long as your expectations aren't too high.
Thank you for your hospitality. 💙

user_reviews.Name: Umar Ahmad
user_reviews.Description:
Terrible Experience – Highly Unsafe and Unhygienic ❌❌❌

I had an extremely disappointing and unpleasant stay at this hotel. The staff was incredibly rude and unprofessional throughout our visit. Shockingly, some of them appeared to be intoxicated while on duty, which is absolutely unacceptable.

They charged us extra for almost everything, with unnecessary fines and hidden fees that were never mentioned upfront. Our room was in a filthy condition — it had cockroaches, and despite multiple complaints, the staff responded with arrogance and even misbehaved with us.

user_reviews.Description: Recently stayed at Mayda Inn and was thoroughly impressed. The hotel ambiance was perfect, and the staff were well mannered. My room was clean and neat, with fresh linen. user_reviews.Name: Benil Agnel
user_reviews.Description:
I booked this hotel for a daytime stay as we had a late-night flight. It was our first visit to Delhi, and due to heavy traffic, we were delayed by about two hours for checkout. The hotel charged us ₹1,500 for the booking and an additional ₹700 for the late checkout. We requested some flexibility considering the situation, but the staff did not accommodate our request.

Regarding the room, it was not well-maintained the walls had damp patches, there was no space to open the window, and the overall cleanliness was below expectations. The TV and telephone were not working, which added to the inconvenience. Despite these issues, we did not complain during the stay, but it certainly impacted the experience.

The stay served its purpose, but the lack of flexibility, poor maintenance, and non-functional amenities left us disappointed. Improving room conditions and customer service would make a significant difference

This is by far the worst hotel I’ve ever seen. The place is extremely unsafe, especially for women. There is no proper security, anyone can walk in and out of the premises without being checked. The corridors are dark and poorly lit, creating a very uncomfortable environment.

The staff is unprofessional and careless – instead of making guests feel secure, they make things worse by ignoring complaints. I personally felt unsafe the entire time I stayed here, and I would never recommend this place to any woman traveling alone or with friends.

The management does not take guest safety seriously. There are no CCTV cameras in important areas, the locks on the doors are weak, and the surroundings outside the hotel feel very unsafe after dark.

If you value your safety and peace of mind, please avoid this hotel at all costs. There are many better and safer options nearby.

user_reviews.Name: PRATYOSH MAHANTA
user_reviews.Description:
We booked this hotel through the MakeMyTrip app, reserving two rooms a month in advance. To our surprise, upon arrival we were informed that only one room was available. They offered us another room in an adjacent building, claiming it was part of their property, but the room quality was far below acceptable standards. Basic amenities such as Wi-Fi password, intercom, kettle, and toiletries were provided only after repeated reminders and nearly an hour of waiting.

After this inconvenience, we went to check the room allotted to our parents, where another issue occurred — my mother got locked inside the bathroom due to a faulty door lock. The door had to be broken open as there was no other way to get her out.

We had booked the stay for one night, but the hotel ensured disappointment at every step. We had also requested packed complimentary breakfast the previous evening, to which they had agreed, but the request was not communicated to the next shift. As expected, this too was mishandled.

The hotel’s location felt unsafe, and although it was listed as a 4-star property on MMT, it did not meet even basic 2-star standards. (It appears their ratings may have been artificially boosted.)

user_reviews.Name: Yuv
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at this hotel before I returned to Israel. It's not a good hotel. The rooms and reception are neglected, the employees are not very nice, the clerk asked to see a Booking.com reception code that I received in the email. Only in retrospect, after I showed him the code, did I think why he asked for it, probably to cancel my reservation from their system or to try to steal my credit information (my card was not saved in the system, so it was impossible to harm me, at most he could have improved his personal situation somehow). At first he wanted to put me in a room on the first floor that was filled with mothballs (they use them to kill insects). After five minutes, I started to get a headache because of them and I told him that I couldn't stay in the room and asked to change. He resisted at first, saying that they would clean the room of the mothballs, but I insisted and then he offered me another room with fewer mothballs, and after I refused the second room as well, he put me up on the third floor and offered me a room with only two mothballs, so I agreed to stay in this room. After the clerk left, I collected the two pills with toilet paper and got rid of them, aired the room, and was relieved. But this is a place I would have avoided. The nearby Casa Central is much better, and in general it is better not to stay in this neighborhood and maybe give up Delhi altogether. New Delhi is the only place I have traveled to in the world that I do not want to return to (and I have traveled to over twenty different countries and hundreds of cities). Maybe if I stayed in a different neighborhood in Delhi and did not travel alone or with a local, it would be a different experience, but I have no desire to return to Delhi under any circumstances.

I wouldn't suggest to go although the receptionist we're all kind, which is maybe the only reason why they deserve 1/5 and not 0.
